Data Center market revenue, 141.213M of 217.646M total. This agrees with the MD&A's 64.9% share. Growth came from 100G and 400G (including the Microsoft deal). It is a data-center line, not an AI one.

Data Center market revenue, 148.525M of 249.365M total. This agrees with the MD&A's 59.5% share. The MD&A ties the demand partly to data center upgrades 'to enable new technologies like AI', but gives no AI split.

Data Center market revenue, 195.651M of 455.715M total. This agrees with the MD&A's 42.9% share. CATV (245.124M) drove most of the year's growth and is excluded. The products are described as building blocks for AI datacenters, but the line is data center, not AI only.
The company expected 400G revenue to keep growing in 2023 on initial Microsoft deliveries. Words only, data-center products, no amount.
The FY2023 MD&A and 2023–2024 releases expected elevated datacenter demand to continue into 2024, based on customer forecasts and backlog. Words only, no amount.
The company expected elevated data center demand into 2025 and a second-half 800G ramp with large hyperscale customers. Words only, no amount.

The FY2025 MD&A expects elevated data center demand to continue into 2026, based on customer forecasts and backlog. Words only. A Q1 2026 Datacenter figure (81.404M) exists, but it is one quarter, not the year.
The Q1 2026 release anticipates a strong 800G volume ramp and sequential revenue growth as capacity comes online. The statement is total-scope, words only, with no AI or datacenter amount.

The release says capacity was expanded for 'next generation datacenter products' (capex 179.148M). This is data center, not stated as AI, and has no amount split. Per the thesis it is none; the Machinery and equipment PP&E growth is not an AI category.
The Q4 2024 release expected 'sizeable capex investments' for increased datacenter production in 2025. Datacenter, not AI, and no amount, so none per the thesis.
The CFO attributed accelerated R&D spending in Q3 2024 to data center customer requests, notably for 1.6T transceivers. Words only, no amount, and data center rather than explicitly AI.
